notablePrerequisites: Dog Walker on the battlefield face up.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dog Walker, adding {R/W}.
When Dog Walker dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Dog Walker from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Dog Walker's disguise ability by paying {R/W}{R/W}, turning it face up.
Dog Walker triggers, creating two 1/1 Dog creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Dog, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.
